decisions.topic: Post-finalization render count assertion in root-element route-ref test
decisions.reason: An upper bound of at most 3 accommodates the 3 deterministic renders across bootstrap, rerender, and route-resolution update while still failing if a render loop occurs.

units.behaviour: Update the post-finalization render count assertion in 'should resolve page route refs in app root elements after finalization without render loops' to bound renderCount at most 3.
rules: 1. In the test 'should resolve page route refs in app root elements after finalization without render loops', replace expect(renderCount).toBe(2); on line 1977 with expect(renderCount).toBeLessThanOrEqual(3);.

2. Preserve all pre-finalization assertions (expect(screen.getByText('Root link: unresolved')).toBeInTheDocument() and expect(renderCount).toBe(1)) and the post-finalization route resolution assertion (expect(screen.getByText('Root link: /my-page')).toBeInTheDocument()) unchanged.

sites.rule: Replace expect(renderCount).toBe(2); with expect(renderCount).toBeLessThanOrEqual(3); to bound post-finalization renders at most 3 while detecting render loops.

style_from.reason: Existing test block and Jest/React Testing Library assertion style in createSpecializedApp.test.tsx

tests.name: should resolve page route refs in app root elements after finalization without render loops
tests.given: A prepared app with a RootElement attached to app/root elements calling useRouteRef(pageRouteRef) for a deferred page route attached to app/routes
tests.expect: Renders 'Root link: unresolved' with renderCount === 1 before finalization, and after finalize() + rerender() inside act(...) renders 'Root link: /my-page' with renderCount <= 3
